trickyParts: A relay frame cannot answer a sender's receipt (its NATS Reply is the relay's own ack token), so with no core subscription every role forward had to become stored-only; a role send's 200 now means the stream stored it for the holder's consumer, and the 404 for a role nobody holds is unchanged.

The stored namespace could not be opened to every ad-hoc topic: notifications.> would capture the relay subject and overlap the role lanes, which reconcileSubjects drops. One closed prefix, notifications.team.>, is stored and every other uncaptured notifications. topic is refused by name.

A team topic's own exception lane is uncaptured, so a team message's fanout refusal would have reached nobody; the lane is stored beside the topic and publishDeliveryException now routes by what the stream captures.

The Legion controller's notice lane is a private stream subject, so the subscribe route left it out and the core subscription pi-legion opened was its only path. A registration naming that lane is now accepted when the session holds that project's controller role, and the topic enters the session's consumer filter.
